intervals.label: VEPP-4M data taking
intervals.note: Year precision. The home page says collection of statistics and data processing are in progress; a new KEDR measurement was posted on arXiv in June 2025 (arXiv:2506.02421).
intervals.quote: In 2002 we started experiments with the universal magnetic detector KEDR at the e+e- collider VEPP-4M in the Budker institute of nuclear physics in Novosibirsk.

summary.plain: The Budker Institute collaboration that built and runs the KEDR detector at VEPP-4M; its spokesman and head is Vladimir E. Blinov.
summary.technical: KEDR collaboration (BINP and partner institutes): spokesman V. E. Blinov (KEDR web site, 2019); author list on the 2013 charmonium paper includes institutes from Novosibirsk and elsewhere.
